## Summary
Seed the MSM course catalog (22 courses with ILO/SLO structure), HetioNet biomedical knowledge network subset, and DrugBank pharmacological data into Neo4j, then create the validate-seed script that comprehensively verifies all E01 seed data and a dev-seed orchestrator for one-command local setup.

## User story
As a developer, I want to run `pnpm run dev-seed` once to populate the entire knowledge graph, and `pnpm run validate-seed` to verify everything is correct, so that I can start building features against a complete local environment.

## Why this matters
MSM catalog courses are the organizational backbone — without them, lectures cannot be assigned to courses, and ILO/SLO hierarchies cannot form. HetioNet provides biomedical entity relationships (gene-disease, drug-gene, etc.) that enrich the knowledge graph for LOD verification. DrugBank provides pharmacological data for drug-related item generation. The validate-seed script is the final quality gate: if it fails, the graph is incomplete and downstream features will break.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 22 MSM Course nodes created with code, title, department, academic_year
- [ ] Courses written to Supabase FIRST, then Neo4j (Rule 6 dual-write)
- [ ] Course ILO nodes created and linked via HAS_ILO edges
- [ ] HetioNet nodes seeded (Gene, Disease, Compound, Anatomy entities + key relationships)
- [ ] DrugBank nodes seeded (Drug, Target, Enzyme entities + key relationships)
- [ ] validate-seed.ts checks ALL seeds from 01 through 11 with pass/fail per check
- [ ] dev-seed.ts runs all seed scripts in correct order (01 -> 02 -> ... -> 11 -> validate)
- [ ] `pnpm run validate-seed` exits 0 with ALL checks passing
- [ ] `pnpm run dev-seed` is idempotent (safe to re-run)
- [ ] All nodes carry institution_id for tenant isolation (Rule 1)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | All Neo4j writes use neo4jQuery — wrapper injects institution_id |
| Rule 6 (G08) | MSM courses: write Supabase FIRST, Neo4j SECOND — Neo4j failure never blocks |
| Rule 8 (D09) | SLO -[:CONTRIBUTES_TO]-> ILO direction (if SLOs are seeded with courses) |
| Rule 9 (G06) | Any TEACHES edges created get cold-start evidence_grade:'C', evidence_weight:0.65 |

## Neo4j edges created/traversed
| Edge | From -> To | Properties | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| HAS_ILO | Course -> ILO | (none) | Course to ILO hierarchy |
| ASSOCIATES_WITH | Gene -> Disease | score, source | HetioNet gene-disease association |
| TARGETS | Drug -> DrugTarget | action_type | DrugBank drug-target relationship |
| TREATS | Drug -> Disease | evidence_level | DrugBank indication |
| INTERACTS_WITH | Drug -> Drug | severity | DrugBank drug-drug interaction subset |

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// scripts/seeds/09-msm-catalog.ts — dual-write pattern (Rule 6)
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

const MSM_COURSES = [
  { code: 'ANAT-501', title: 'Gross Anatomy', department: 'Anatomy', academic_year: '2025-2026' },
  { code: 'BIOC-501', title: 'Medical Biochemistry', department: 'Biochemistry', academic_year: '2025-2026' },
  // ... 22 total
]

async function seedMSMCatalog(institutionId: string) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()

  for (const course of MSM_COURSES) {
    // Rule 6: Supabase FIRST
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('courses')
      .upsert({
        institution_id: institutionId,
        code: course.code,
        title: course.title,
        academic_year: course.academic_year,
        neo4j_sync_status: 'pending',
      }, { onConflict: 'institution_id,code' })
      .select()
      .single()

    if (error) {
      console.error(`[seed] Supabase write failed for ${course.code}:`, error)
      continue
    }

    // Rule 6: Neo4j SECOND (failure logged, never blocks)
    const result = await neo4jQuery(
      `MERGE (c:Course {code: $code, institution_id: $institution_id})
       ON CREATE SET c.uuid = $uuid, c.title = $title, c.department = $department,
                     c.academic_year = $academic_year, c.created_at = datetime()
       ON MATCH SET c.title = $title, c.updated_at = datetime()`,
      { uuid: data.id, code: course.code, title: course.title,
        department: course.department, academic_year: course.academic_year },
      institutionId
    )

    // Update sync status
    await supabase.from('courses').update({
      neo4j_synced_at: result ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
      neo4j_sync_status: result ? 'synced' : 'failed',
    }).eq('id', data.id)
  }
}

// scripts/seeds/validate-seed.ts — comprehensive validation
async function validateSeed(institutionId: string) {
  const checks: { name: string; pass: boolean; detail?: string }[] = []

  // Check 01: Reference nodes
  const bloomResult = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (b:BloomLevel {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(b) as count',
    {}, institutionId
  )
  checks.push({
    name: '01-reference-nodes: BloomLevel',
    pass: bloomResult?.records[0]?.count === 6,
    detail: `Expected 6, got ${bloomResult?.records[0]?.count ?? 'null'}`,
  })

  // ... checks for ALL seed scripts 01-11

  // Print results
  console.log('\n=== SEED VALIDATION RESULTS ===\n')
  let allPass = true
  for (const check of checks) {
    const icon = check.pass ? '✓' : '✗'
    console.log(`  ${icon} ${check.name} ${check.detail ? `(${check.detail})` : ''}`)
    if (!check.pass) allPass = false
  }
  console.log(`\n${allPass ? '✓ ALL CHECKS PASSED' : '✗ SOME CHECKS FAILED'}\n`)
  process.exit(allPass ? 0 : 1)
}

// scripts/seeds/dev-seed.ts — orchestrator
import { execSync } from 'child_process'

const SEED_ORDER = [
  '01-reference-nodes',
  '02-misconception-categories',
  '03-task-shells',
  '04-anatomy-regions',
  '05-usmle-taxonomy',
  '06-lcme-standards',
  '07-ipec-care-phase',
  '08-few-shot-examples',
  '09-msm-catalog',
  '10-hetionet',
  '11-drugbank',
]

for (const seed of SEED_ORDER) {
  console.log(`\n>>> Running ${seed}...`)
  execSync(`pnpm tsx scripts/seeds/${seed}.ts`, { stdio: 'inherit' })
}
console.log('\n>>> Running validate-seed...')
execSync('pnpm tsx scripts/seeds/validate-seed.ts', { stdio: 'inherit' })
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-01: Raw neo4j-driver import
import neo4j from 'neo4j-driver'  // BANNED

// ✗ Rule 6 violation: Neo4j write before Supabase
await neo4jQuery('MERGE (c:Course ...)', ...)   // WRONG ORDER
await supabase.from('courses').upsert(...)       // Should be FIRST

// ✗ Rule 8 violation: Wrong SLO direction
// ILO -[:CONTRIBUTES_TO]-> SLO  // BANNED — direction is SLO -> ILO

// ✗ Promise.all for batch seed operations
await Promise.all(courses.map(seedCourse))  // WRONG — use Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)

// ✗ validate-seed silently passing on null results
if (!result) return  // WRONG — null result from graceful degradation should be a check failure
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E01/E01-S08.seed.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

const TEST_INSTITUTION = process.env.TEST_INSTITUTION_ID ?? 'test-institution-001'
const supabase = createClient(
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
  process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
)

test('Acceptance: 22 MSM Course nodes in Neo4j', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (c:Course {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(c) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].count).toBe(22)
})

test('Acceptance: 22 courses in Supabase', async () => {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id')
    .eq('institution_id', TEST_INSTITUTION)
  expect(error).toBeNull()
  expect(data).toHaveLength(22)
})

test('Acceptance: courses have ILO edges', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (c:Course {institution_id: $institution_id})-[:HAS_ILO]->(ilo:ILO)
     RETURN count(DISTINCT c) as courses_with_ilos`,
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records[0].courses_with_ilos).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10)
})

test('Acceptance: dual-write sync status is correct', async () => {
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('neo4j_sync_status')
    .eq('institution_id', TEST_INSTITUTION)
  const synced = data?.filter(c => c.neo4j_sync_status === 'synced')
  // Most should be synced (some may have failed if Neo4j was flaky)
  expect(synced?.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20)
})

test('Acceptance: HetioNet nodes exist', async () => {
  const geneResult = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (g:Gene {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(g) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(geneResult).not.toBeNull()
  expect(geneResult!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)

  const diseaseResult = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (d:Disease {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(d) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(diseaseResult).not.toBeNull()
  expect(diseaseResult!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
})

test('Acceptance: DrugBank nodes exist', async () => {
  const drugResult = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (d:Drug {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(d) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(drugResult).not.toBeNull()
  expect(drugResult!.records[0].count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
})

test('Acceptance: validate-seed passes', async () => {
  const { execSync } = await import('child_process')
  expect(() => execSync('pnpm run validate-seed')).not.toThrow()
})

test('Acceptance: dev-seed is idempotent', async () => {
  const beforeCourses = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (c:Course {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(c) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  const { execSync } = await import('child_process')
  execSync('pnpm run dev-seed', { timeout: 300000 })
  const afterCourses = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (c:Course {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(c) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(beforeCourses!.records[0].count).toBe(afterCourses!.records[0].count)
})

test('Negative: validate-seed fails if reference nodes missing', async () => {
  // This test verifies validate-seed actually catches problems
  // by checking that it would fail on an empty graph
  // (Run on a separate test institution with no seeds)
  const { execSync } = await import('child_process')
  try {
    execSync('TEST_INSTITUTION_ID=empty-test pnpm run validate-seed')
    // Should not reach here
    expect(true).toBe(false)
  } catch {
    // Expected — validate-seed should fail on empty graph
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  }
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. Remove MSM course data from Supabase:
   ```sql
   DELETE FROM courses WHERE institution_id = '[test-institution-id]';
   ```
2. Remove all seeded nodes from Neo4j:
   ```cypher
   MATCH (n) WHERE n:Course OR n:ILO OR n:Gene OR n:Disease OR n:Compound OR n:Drug OR n:DrugTarget DETACH DELETE n
   ```
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
